reply.emotion: organized and forward-looking, ready to plan the weeks ahead
notes: Use 'calendario' both for the physical object hanging on the wall and for the digital app on your phone.

senses.definition: A system of organizing days for a given year, usually displayed as a book, a page, or a chart.

examples.text: Controllo il calendario per vedere quando abbiamo le vacanze.
examples.translation: I check the calendar to see when we have the holidays.
examples.emotion: thoughtful and planning ahead, looking for upcoming free time

senses.definition: A single printed page showing the days, weeks, and months of a specific period.

examples.text: Ho strappato il vecchio calendario di marzo.
examples.translation: I tore off the old calendar page for March.
examples.emotion: satisfaction in turning the page to start a new month
